title: EIA Cushing WTI crude oil future contract 1
author: U.S. Energy Information Administration

chunks.heading: Series identity
chunks.body: EIA identifies RCLC1 as Cushing, Oklahoma crude oil future contract 1 in dollars per barrel and exposes a keyless XLS history.

chunks.heading: Campaign coverage failure
chunks.body: The downloaded daily workbook returned only 66 observations in 2024 through April 4 and none in the second validation window, so it cannot support the portfolio campaign.
